title: Bryan Lawrence VALUEx BRK 2026
description:
Meet Marvin and Vicki, Our AI Agents at Oakcliff 
Two AI agents running on Mac minis. Bryan's takeaway: businesses with revenues denominated in human time but costs in tokens face a structural problem.

See the full stream of the event here: https://youtube.com/live/V3V7bqLGP9o
summary: The speakers argue that value investors have historically achieved significant leverage by managing large capital with very few people, a feat they claim AI cannot replicate without human oversight. They further contend that while AI agents like Marvin can tirelessly apply frameworks and compound memory, they lack the human instinct to detect when something feels off and drift toward confident mediocrity without human discussion to act as a quality filter.
